item.title: NASA Is Still Aiming for the Next Moon Landing in 2028

item.title: Are Fewer Teens Identifying as Gay or Bisexual? It’s Complicated.
item.description: New data have prompted questions about changes in teens’ sexual orientations. But researchers disagree on how much the numbers can really tell us.
